name: Lunar Secret
original_name: พระจันทร์ซ่อนเงา
overview: When 'Pawida' (Honey), a leading model known as the 'Princess on the Catwalk' has to clash with 'Alin' a top-tier actress dubbed the 'Angel of the Industry.'  Their once-beautiful friendship falls apart because of rumors and misunderstandings, turning them into a 'sworn enemy pair' who can no longer work together. Everything changes when 'Pawida' accidentally discovers 'Alin's' secret— a secret that the other party never intended for anyone to know. Just like 'Pawida' herself, who has a past that should never be exposed. Paths in life that were never meant to cross are inexplicably pulled together. If both of them are like the moon in the night sky, no one knows what is hidden beneath that glowing light. And who knows... how the story of this actress and model duo will ultimately end?
